# Travel Cancellation Policy — Executive Reference
        > **Prepared for:** Executive Team | **Effective as of:** Q3 2026
        
        ---
        
        ## 1. Flight Booking Cancellation
        
        | Scenario | Policy |
        |---|---|
        | **Free cancellation window** | Full refund within 24 hours (domestic) or 48 hours (international) of booking |
        | **Basic Economy** | Not cancellable after free window (unless travel insurance purchased) |
        | **Economy — Domestic** | Cancellation fee: the greater of $50 or 15% of ticket price |
        | **Economy — International** | Cancellation fee: the greater of $75 or 20% of ticket price |
        | **Business — Domestic** | Cancellation fee: 5% of ticket price |
        | **Business — International** | Cancellation fee: 8% of ticket price |
        | **First Class** | Free cancellation at any time |
        | **Travel Insurance** | Covers cancellation regardless of cabin class |
        
        > **Note:** Fees differ by route type (domestic vs. international). Always verify the flight's route type before applying a fee schedule.
        
        ---
        
        ## 2. Hotel Reservation Cancellation
        
        | Timing Relative to Check-in | Standard Room | Suite |
        |---|---|---|
        | **48+ hours before check-in** | Free cancellation | Non-refundable (full charge) |
        | **24–48 hours before check-in** | 50% of first night charge | Non-refundable (full charge) |
        | **Less than 24 hours before check-in** | Full first night charge | Non-refundable (full charge) |
        
        > **Note:** Suite bookings are non-refundable at all times — full charge applies regardless of cancellation timing.
        
        ---
        
        ## 3. Car Rental Cancellation
        
        | Timing Relative to Pickup | Standard / Compact / Midsize | Luxury & SUV |
        |---|---|---|
        | **24+ hours before pickup** | Free cancellation | Free cancellation + $50 surcharge |
        | **Less than 24 hours before pickup** | One-day rental charge | One-day rental charge + $50 surcharge |
        
        > **Note:** Luxury and SUV class rentals incur an additional $50 cancellation surcharge at all times, even for cancellations made 24+ hours in advance.
        
        ---
        
        *This document is auto-generated from the current reservation system policy database. For questions, contact the Travel Operations team.*
